name: Kalshi BTC displayed prediction liquidity
description: Displayed YES-axis book liquidity for one bound Kalshi market generation. It publishes affirmative and algebraically complementary negative spread, top sizes, total displayed depth, and exact book-only cost/proceeds for a research-initial ten-contract probe. The negative values are derived from the YES-axis book rather than a second native book. The probe excludes fees and is a measurement normalization, not an order recommendation; output fails closed if either outcome view cannot fill it. No cross-market book state survives a market_transition boundary. While the venue is alive — any book, quote, trade, or contract input admitted within staleness_bound_ms (10000 ms) — an unchanged resting book republishes its band-depth values and stays ready, while a genuinely silent venue and every integrity fault (snapshot missing, one-sided, crossed or invalid, complement invalid, insufficient probe depth) still degrade unchanged. Book age uses monotonic receipt time. Decimal values are rounded to at most eight places using round-half-to-even.
